customManagers.description: Keep the Dockerfile's pnpm pin in step with packageManager.

packageRules.description: Heavy automerge for everything — CI (lint, typecheck, build, smoke game, Docker image boot, CodeQL, Trivy) is the safety net, so anything that stays green merges itself.
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR.
Move Node.js together: the Docker base image and the CI runtime must match.
Move pnpm together: packageManager and the Dockerfile's corepack pin must match.
Hold pnpm majors: newer majors refuse to run unapproved dependency build scripts (esbuild, sharp), which needs a config migration, not a version bump.
Hold TypeScript on v6 until typescript-eslint supports the v7 native compiler (same hold as in Jync).
Hold ESLint 10 until eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-import (pulled in by eslint-config-next) support it; on v10 they crash with 'contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function'.
